body:
I suspect that this has to do with this line: https://github.com/neovim/neovim/blob/e921e98ce38a33a824a8b4efb376a9901a8191d7/third-party/cmake/BuildLuajit.cmake#L61

LuaJIT recommends `amalg` builds for performance, but apparently this doesn't play nice with parallel builds via `make -j`. Note that it seems to work fine both for me and CI when using `ninja`, which is a recommended build dependency -- do you have that installed? 

1. if not, could you install it and try again? (Note: if `ninja` is installed, `make` is automatically parallelized _without_ any `-j` flag!)
2. if yes, could you try removing the `amalg` from the line above and try again?
Following @clason suggestion, using `-j1` instead of `-j4` fixes this issue for me.
That's nice, but that wasn't actually my suggestion :)

> That's nice, but that wasn't actually my suggestion :)

I think the issue is related to parallel builds, not the other stuff. I have `ninja` installed, not `amalg`. The short-term solution seems to be not to compile in parallel.

OK, if you have `ninja` installed, you should _not_ be using `make -j`.

`amalg` is not a tool but a build target -- can you change the line 61 in `third-party/cmake/BuildLuajit.cmake` to just `install)` (remove the `amalg`)?

(_All_ of this is related to parallel builds. My suspicion is that `make -j` -- but not `ninja` parallelizes the build targets as well, which leads to conflicts.)
